messages.subject: g.part2 errors
parts:
Kia ora,

I have been using the GGIR package to analyse data from GeneActiv branded accelerometers. I have about 35 files in bin format to analyse and the first 30 processed with no issues.

However on the last five files I am getting the following errors:

Errors and warnings for meta_P35.bin.RData$message
[1] "only 0's may be mixed with negative subscripts"

$call
averageday[a56:a57, (mi - 1)]

I have checked the files and they aren't corrupt and contain data. I have unpicked the code enough to know that the error is coming from g.part2 and the g.analyse.perday function within. But other than that I have no idea what is causing the code to fail.

I am just using the g.shell.GGIR code with default arguments.

Many thanks for the help,

Ellie Johnson
